title: O'Deadly Skyrim
tagline: Lets O'Deadly Skyrim ask whether a character would act, based on their bio.
description: Decision template used by O'Deadly Skyrim (A SkyrimNet environmental mod). When the mod is about to involve a real NPC, it asks SkyrimNet's decision model whether that character, given their bio and the situation, would do it. Without a decisions provider the mod falls back to its own character filter.
author: That Guy (Coronerra)
